title: Completed integral coefficient sheaf
statement:
For the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], fix a prime
$\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and
uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and for $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ the finite coefficient
rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with their reduction homomorphisms
$A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].
Fix a scheme $Y$ and use its small pro-etale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], on which $(A_{E,n})_Y$ is the constant sheaf of
rings (the sheafification of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto A_{E,n}$) and
$\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ is the abelian category of sheaves of
$(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules. By functoriality of sheafification the reduction
homomorphisms induce morphisms of sheaves of rings
$(A_{E,n+1})_Y\to(A_{E,n})_Y$. The completed coefficient sheaf is

$$
 \widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_Y,
$$

the inverse limit of this system in the category of sheaves of rings
[def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit], with limit projections
$\pi_n:\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\to(A_{E,n})_Y$. Let
$\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and
let $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ be its derived category, the
localization of its cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms
[def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; this notation does not mean modules over
the discrete constant sheaf $(\mathcal O_E)_Y$. The cohomology sheaves
$\mathcal H^r(K)$ of a complex $K$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules are
its cohomology objects $\ker d^r/\operatorname{im}d^{r-1}$ in the abelian
category $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$
[def-weil-abstract-derived-category] (those of the standard $t$-structure).
For every $n$,

$$
 \operatorname{Res}_n:
 \Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})
 \longrightarrow\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)
$$

denotes the restriction of scalars along $\pi_n$
[def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], which makes every sheaf of
$(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules a sheaf of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules; its
exactness is a separate statement.

split_report.summary: Checked against the master blueprint text (slopmaster2 has the same definition in src/version/sketch/46_weil_structures_weights.tex lines 64-70) and against Bhatt-Scholze arXiv:1309.1198 §6.5 (R̂_X := lim R/m^n) and Def. 6.8.1/Lemma 6.8.2(1) (Ô_{E,X} = lim O_E/ϖ^n). Statement dependencies rewritten to name every notion used: the coefficient rings A_{E,n} and reductions now come from def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension (not from def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, which only repeated the notation); the inverse limit of sheaves of rings is def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit; the module category is a new Mathlib leaf (def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category = SheafOfModules) and restriction of scalars is the Mathlib leaf def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars; the duplicate def-weil-sheaf-restriction-of-scalars created here is marked merged into it); the derived category and the cohomology sheaves of complexes of Ô-modules are def-weil-abstract-derived-category (def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves is stated only for constant-ring coefficients A_Y, so it does not cover Ô-modules and was dropped). def-weil-derived-tensor was dropped: the statement mentioned it but defines nothing with it. The unproved claim that π_n : Ô → (A_{E,n})_Y is a surjection was removed (the definition of Res_n works for any ring map; surjectivity holds by BS Prop. 4.2.8 + Prop. 3.2.3(1) + Def. 3.1.1 but is not needed here); the sentence on reduction maps between constant sheaves is now stated via functoriality of sheafification. Mathlib's Scheme.ellAdicSheaf is not a match (sheaf of abelian groups U ↦ C(U,ℤ_ℓ), only E = Q_ℓ, isomorphic to this node's sheaf only through BS Lemma 6.8.2(1)).
